title: Katelyn Butcher releases a wonderful single "Angel on my shoulder"
htmlContent:
Singer and songwriter Katelyn Butcher releases a wonderful single called "Angel on my shoulder," a follow-up of her recent singles called “I Miss You, But I Don’t” and “Goodbye Boy” which received hundreds of thousands of streams. She is back again to take over the music industry with her new song "Angel on my shoulder".

Katelyn Butcher's "Angel on my shoulder" is exciting music at it’s finest that makes you fall in love with music all over again. The appeal in the music shines with a digestible sound anyone who listens will enjoy, but also the soul in it resonates as well, with each element filling good to take in on this record you will want to listen to every chance you get.

Follow Katelyn Butcher on Instagram.
